description.value: Kamamarui is a compact, 24-seat Japanese ramen restaurant in Burnaby's Royal Oak neighbourhood, centred on tonkotsu, miso, and chicken broth bowls alongside donburi rice dishes and classic Japanese appetizers. The kitchen offers both meat-based and fully vegan ramen, giving cyclists with dietary restrictions a genuine option. Online ordering is available, making it a practical quick-service stop along the Royal Oak corridor.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: stands (5 spaces) at 54m; stands (5 spaces) at 65m. Total: 10 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website (kamamarui.com) is live with posts dated January–April 2026, confirming the business is open; however the site consistently uses the name 'Kamamarui Ramen & Don' and the menu contains no sushi items, which conflicts with the OSM name 'Kamamarui Ramen & Sushi'. Vegan ramen options ('Black Vegan Ramen', 'Miso Vegan Ramen') and an 'Online Order' link provide positive evidence for vegan options and takeout respectively. No evidence of bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or any other cycling-specific amenity appears in the website content or OSM tags.
concerns: Name mismatch: OSM records 'Kamamarui Ramen & Sushi' but the website consistently uses 'Kamamarui Ramen & Don' and the current menu contains no sushi items.
Phone number (+1-604-435-1675) could not be confirmed via website content; no contact number is displayed on the site.

enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Legitimate food-stop candidate for cyclists, but the required bike parking criterion is unconfirmed and the OSM name does not match the current trading name on the website; on-site verification would resolve both issues.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu lists 'Black Vegan Ramen' (vegan soup base, tofu, black fungus) and 'Miso Vegan Ramen' (miso soup base, tofu, bean sprout, corn)
